about_the_game:
Precision counts. Each level presents a simple yet satisfying challenge: hit every tomato using a limited number of shots.

In demo you can play 5 levels of 2 stages.

Each stage levels starting with slow-moving and gradually increasing in speed and difficulty. As you progress, you'll encounter tomatoes of various sizes and distances, testing your aim and timing.

You can play any stage independently, even if you haven't completed the previous ones. This give you freedom to explore other challenges.

  • Stage 1 features static tomatoes - learn how to play.

  • Stage 2 targets move in different patterns.

You can reset your progress on any stage and replay it from the beginning, or jump into any level you've already unlocked.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (21H1)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent SSE2
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (21H1)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580+
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
